notes: Medical: all 17 claims map to allowed sources (PMC/PubMed reviews; s5 is a single small trial used only for the explicitly 'early' claim c13). The lactic-acid belief is named a myth. No doses, supplements, drugs, brands, or forbidden words. Protein advice is about food ('meals with protein'), with no amounts. Disclaimer is in the description, and the outro template always shows it.

Minor, non-blocking: c1 is a rhetorical question, so its 'proven' label is only formal. c15 'sleep well' is labeled proven, but direct human evidence on recovery speed is limited (the fact-check warning notes this). Optional: the myth shot's 'fact' text ('That's mostly a myth') repeats the MYTH label. A short sourced fact (e.g. 'Acid clears in hours', from s6) would add information, but only if the narration still matches.

Hook: 'Training five days a week but not growing?' has 8 words, names a relatable pain, and appears as an example formula in HOOKS.md. The 'you' comes in the second sentence. The video answers the hook (repair and building happen during rest; protein and sleep help) and promises no result.

Templates: 13 shots across 11 distinct templates (hook, zoom, fiber x3, organ, flow, graph, guide x2, myth, bars, outro). The visuals are custom diagrams synced to the narration. Graph and bars are qualitative and consistent with s3 (~48 h) and s5 (~18% lower).

Packaging: all titles are 60 characters or fewer and none are clickbait. The description lists sources and the disclaimer. Licenses: only the Montserrat font (OFL 1.1) is listed; there is no music, and all graphics are drawn in code.
summary_ru: Ролик готов к публикации. У каждого утверждения есть надёжный источник, уровни доказанности честные, миф про молочную кислоту назван мифом, дозировок и добавок нет, дисклеймер есть и в описании, и на последнем кадре. Хук цепляет и честно раскрыт, шаблоны кадров разнообразны, заголовки без кликбейта. Мелкие необязательные замечания (подпись на кадре с мифом, формальная метка у вопроса-хука) публикации не мешают.
